items.title: Nevercenter releases Silo 2027.0
items.excerpt: The lightweight 3D modeler adds a JavaScript API with 100+ functions and an MCP server, letting external AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT generate primitives, edit meshes, and handle selections, materials, UVs and cameras. Perpetual licence $159. (Body date Tue 17 Nov 2026; time from Google News index.)

items.excerpt: At Formnext 2026, Tripo AI previewed H3.5, an upcoming 3D-native foundation model aimed at print-ready output with finer detail than H3.1, and Polipop, an agent that takes an idea through 3D modeling and print prep and sends the job to a printer.

items.excerpt: Drawing on new research, Andrew Chung argues that AI has sped up how teams design and build while accessibility QA has not kept pace, and lays out what separates teams that are keeping up and how to embed human judgment into AI-enabled workflows.

items.title: Pin agent color usage to semantic tokens — no raw hex in JSX
items.excerpt: Coding agents drop one-off hex values like #FF4D4F into JSX, bypassing the danger token and breaking dark mode; the post shows how to make semantic color tokens a merge gate for agent-written UI.

items.title: MAI Image 2.7: Frontier quality at a fraction of the cost
items.excerpt: Microsoft launched MAI Image 2.7 and 2.7 Flash at Ignite, with fine-grained edits to an object's color, material or position, transparent-background output and a Canvas workspace. It ranks #1 on Artificial Analysis image editing at 1,215 Elo; about $35 per 1,000 images ($10 for Flash), in preview on Foundry, fal, OpenRouter and Vercel. (microsoft.ai is off-list; the on-list mirror is the vercel.com AI Gateway changelog.)

items.title: Instagram's new tool for creators targets unauthorized reposts and AI-modified videos

items.title: Anyone can create a personal avatar of themselves in Google Vids, at no cost.
items.excerpt: Google Vids now lets anyone build a free custom AI avatar of themselves from a selfie and a voice recording, then use it to narrate videos.

items.title: Product Design Engineering: What It Is and How It Works
items.excerpt: With AI tools turning prompts into working interfaces, Eleken describes product design engineering, where designers build interfaces from AI and existing components while engineers review the code. It cites the AI in Design 2026 report (900+ designers), in which half said they had shipped AI-generated code to production. This is an agency blog post.

items.title: See what 5 builders are making with Gemini 4 Carbon
items.excerpt: Google showcases five developers using Gemini 4 Carbon to build complex simulations, interactive data tools and detailed virtual environments through the Gemini API, AI Studio and Android Studio. Its design angle is weak.

items.title: Claude Can Now Turn Ideas Into Visual Whiteboards
items.excerpt: The AI Advantage walks through Claude's Whiteboards feature, which groups spoken, typed or drawn ideas into a visual board that can be exported to Lucid or Miro. The video is fresh, but secondary sources date the feature's launch to around 10 Nov.

items.title: Manage an allowlist of approved OAuth apps, including MCP clients
items.excerpt: Figma Design admins on Organization and Enterprise plans can now allowlist approved OAuth apps, including MCP clients such as Cursor and Claude Code, and review app requests in a new Extensions tab of the admin console; rolling out over the next few days.
